content.question: Why do neural networks need activation functions?
options: They reduce the number of neurons required in the input layer.
They replace the bias term in every neuron.
They introduce non-linearity - without it, the network would simply represent a linear transformation of its inputs.
They allow the network to be trained without any data.
content.answer: They introduce non-linearity - without it, the network would simply represent a linear transformation of its inputs.
